verdict.rationale: Mailchimp documents per-campaign email reports with open and click rates, including which recipients clicked and how many times each link was clicked. Campaign ROI and revenue attribution are covered by e-commerce tracking and Analytics AI, which names both campaigns and automations as revenue drivers. However, the core reporting evidence is campaign-level only. missing for 10: per-automation-step metrics, unsubscribe reporting for marketing campaigns (only a Transactional webhook event is shown), over-time trend views, native conversion tracking outside integrations like Magento, independent or hands-on corroboration.
